info.title: Rozen Maiden: Traumend
info.synopsis: Secondo capitolo della serie. La storia si svolge come al solito nella casa di Jun, e qui ritroveremo le meravigliose bambole di Rozen: Shinku, Hina Ichigo, e le due gemelle Suisei Seki e Souisei Seki. In questo secondo capitolo le bambole coinvolte nel "gioco di Alice" diventano sette, con due new entry: Kanaria, una piccola pasticciona armata di violino, e Bara Suishou, la misteriosa sorella più giovane. Oltre alle nuove bambole, vengono presentati anche due nuovi personaggi: l'apprendista di Rozen, e il "bianconiglio".

episodes.title: Rose Crystal: Rozenkristall
episodes.synopsis: Jun has overcome his past and must now make up all his schoolwork before he can actually go back. Suiseiseki and Souseiseki barge into the Sakurada residence as usual, the dolls play with each other, and everything is back to normal. However, Shinku starts to face deep nightmares about Suigintou. Barasuishou, the fraud of the seventh doll of the Rozen Maiden, is introduced.

episodes.title: Enju: Enju
episodes.synopsis: Shinku claims that Barasuishou never meet any of the dolls of the Rozen Maiden. Since Barasuishou is the seventh doll, this appears to be a sign that the Alice Game would be ending soon. Shinku's strange behavior continues, and Jun continues to worry about her. Jun and Tomoe also visit the doll shop of a doll maker named Enju.

episodes.title: Kanaria: Kanarienvogel
episodes.synopsis: Kanaria, the second doll of the Rozen Maiden, is introduced. Her initial plan is to sneak into the Sakurada residence and take the Rosa Mysticae from Shinku, Hinaichigo, Suiseiseki, and Souseiseki. However, chaos erupts as the dolls think that a burglar broke in.

episodes.title: Contract: Vereinbarung
episodes.synopsis: Suiseiseki decides to find a medium, as Jun is the only one eligible, though she is skeptical about him. Ultimately, Jun and the five dolls are taken to the world of Barasuishou, where the Alice Game is foreshadowed. Jun enters into a contract with Suiseiseki.

episodes.title: Letter: Der Brief
episodes.synopsis: Hinaichigo tries to send a letter to Jun. Suiseiseki tries to earn Jun's respect. Souseiseki tries to keep order in the house Kanaria tries to get into the Sakurada residence yet again. Jun and Shinku are in the background during these events.

episodes.title: Angel: Engel
episodes.synopsis: Megu, hospitalized with an incurable disease, enters into a contract with Suigintou. However, Megu wishes only for death and insists that she is incomplete and broken. After encountering Barasuishou, and later Shinku, it is realized that Suigintou was revived to participate in the Alice Game.

episodes.title: Tea Party: Teegesellschaft
episodes.synopsis: Kanaria makes her resolve to fight, in order to both remain alive and to make her medium, Micchan, happy. However, conflicts get resolved and Kanaria fulfills Micchan's wish a different way. Meanwhile, Souseiseki starts to see deeper into the Alice Game and begins to believe that she and her sisters should fight.

episodes.title: Doll Maker: Puppenmacher
episodes.synopsis: After having seen an apparition of Rozen, the creator of the dolls of the Rozen Maiden, Souseiseki soon sees the deep meaning behind the Alice Game. After having seen Enju and his feelings about dolls, Jun starts to wonder more about Rozen and his love for his dolls. Souseiseki resolves to fight her sisters, take their Rosa Mysticae, and become Alice.

episodes.title: The Reproach: Der Tadel
episodes.synopsis: Suiseiseki becomes worried about Souseiseki. Souseiseki battles against Barasuishou and Suigintou, only to be defeated. Souseiseki asks Suiseiseki to take her Rosa Mystica, but Suiseiseki fails and Suigintou takes Souseiseki's Rosa Mystica.

episodes.title: Tomoe: Tomoe
episodes.synopsis: Souseiseki is destined to meet a tragic fate, and to make matters worse, Shinku sees the same for Hinaichigo as well. Hinaichigo is also aware of her destiny, and shares her last moments with Tomoe. There is no time to mourn, however, since Barasuishou, Laplace, and Enju have apparently laid a trap for Jun and the remaining dolls of the Rozen Maiden.

episodes.title: Rose Garden: Rosengarten
episodes.synopsis: Because they have yet to fulfill Rozen's wish, the remaining dolls fight Barasuishou and Suigintou. When things spiral downward, Shinku is left to fight Barasuishou.

episodes.title: Alice: Alice
episodes.synopsis: The conflicts are solved, the battles are ended. Jun learns the shocking truth about Barasuishou, Enju, and Rozen. Enju was the maker of Barasuishou, not Rozen, therefore, Barasuishou perishes, while the other dolls of the Rozen Maiden will soon be revived.

related.plot: Jun è il classico hikikomori che passa in casa le sue giornate per evitare incontri con persone diverse dalla sua servile sorella. Il suo hobby è acquistare attraverso internet oggetti "magici" che si rivelano costantemente delle bufale e che con grande soddisfazione Jun rimanda al mittente dopo averne testato l'inutilità. A seguito di un'ordinazione un po' strana, però, Jun entra in possesso di Shinku, una bambola molto particolare: trattasi di un essere vivente che lega a sé il malcapitato con un anello per farne il suo servitore.

related.title: Rozen Maiden: Zurückspulen
related.plot: Sakurada Jun era un ragazzo che rifiutava di tornare a scuola in seguito ad un forte trauma lì ricevuto. Il suo incontro con la bambola animata Shinku, però, cambiò la sua vita trascinandolo in una strana e misteriosa battaglia chiamata Alice Game e alla quale tutte le bambole create dal misterioso Rozen (come appunto Shinku) dovevano partecipare. Jun si è ritrovò quindi a diventare il servitore di Shinku oltre il medium che permette alla bambola di prendere vita, e di battaglia in battaglia, inesorabilmente, anche ad affrontare e risolvere i suoi problemi personali fino a riguadagnare finalmente la serenità  di un tempo. Risolta però la situazione personale di Jun, ancora molti sembrano i misteri legati all'Alice Game e alle misteriose bambole di Rozen: ecco quindi tornare anche gli altri vecchi personaggi della prima serie, come la graziosa Hina Ichigo o la perfida Suiseiseki accompagnata dal più misurato fratello Souseiseki, tutti in forze al seguito di quella che è stata una prima stagione di successo.
